data.title: Hims & Hers Defends Subscription Practices And Privacy Disclosures Against Lawsuit
data.description: Hims & Hers seeks dismissal of a consumer lawsuit, arguing upfront disclosures refute claims about user privacy, billing, and cancellations.

data.title: QUICK SPARK: ACVF ETF Dumps Wells Fargo, US Bancorp Over Debanking Concerns
data.description: ACVF has sold its Wells Fargo and U.S. Bancorp holdings following an OCC report on politicized debanking, adding both banks to its boycott list.

data.title: NVR Faces Double Squeeze As Homebuyers Retreat and Construction Costs Climb
data.description: NVR drops after Bank of America downgraded it to Underperform, citing weak orders, margins and demand; price target cut to $5,900.

data.title: Oil Tops $100 on Iran Fears, Energy ETF XLE Hits New Record: Stock Market Today
data.description: WTI crude rose above $100 on fears of renewed U.S. strikes on Iran, lifting XLE to a record while staples, telecoms and the Dow slipped at midday Friday.

data.title: Chevron Stock Moves Higher: What's Going On?
data.description: Chevron (NYSE: CVX) shares are jumping Friday as crude oil climbs on growing expectations that the U.S. could strike Iran again within weeks.
